mapper.select: /*getKeyWord*/ SELECT MAX (DECODE (CNT, 1, KEY_WORD1, ' ')) AS KEY_1, MAX (DECODE (CNT, 2, KEY_WORD1, ' ')) AS KEY_2, MAX (DECODE (CNT, 3, KEY_WORD1, ' ')) AS KEY_3, MAX (DECODE (CNT, 4, KEY_WORD1, ' ')) AS KEY_4, MAX (DECODE (CNT, 5, KEY_WORD1, ' ')) AS KEY_5 FROM (SELECT ROWNUM AS CNT, KEY_WORD1 FROM ( SELECT KEY_WORD1 FROM (SELECT KEY_WORD1 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD2 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD3 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD4 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD5 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD6 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD7 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD8 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD9 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD10 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD11 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD12 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD13 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD14 FROM PRMTVISH UNION ALL SELECT KEY_WORD15 FROM PRMTVISH) WHERE KEY_WORD1 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.RANDOM))

/*getCatalogItemPlan*/ SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT DECODE (A.IMG_NAME, NULL, '/resources/images/icon_emptyimg.gif', '/' || A.IMG_DIR || '/' || A.IMG_NAME) IMG_NAME, A.ITEM_NO ITEM_NO, A.DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION SPECIFICATION, TO_CHAR (A.USER_PRICE, 'FM999,999,999,990') USER_PRICE, A.CATEGORY_NO CATEGORY_NO, (SELECT PID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND STD_CATEG_ID = A.CATEGORY_NO) PID FROM PRMTITEM A WHERE A.ITEM_FLAG = 'G' AND A.ITEM_STATUS = 'N' AND A.STATUS ^= 'D' ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.RANDOM) A WHERE ROWNUM <= 3

/*getCatalogMainItem*/ SELECT PID, CATEGORY_NO, IMG_NAME, ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, MAKER_NAME, USER_PRICE, CATEG_NAME, PID_CATEG_NAME FROM (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT A.PID, B.CATEGORY_NO, DECODE ( B.IMG_NAME, NULL, '/resources/images/icon_emptyimg.gif', '/' || B.IMG_DIR || '/' || B.IMG_NAME) IMG_NAME, B.ITEM_NO, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPECIFICATION, B.MAKER_NAME, B.USER_PRICE, A.CATEG_NAME, (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND STD_CATEG_ID = A.PID) AS PID_CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA A, PRMTITEM B WHERE A.STD_CATEG_ID = B.CATEGORY_NO AND A.PID = '2' AND A.COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND B.STATUS = 'C') ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.RANDOM) UNION ALL SELECT '2' AS PID, 'NO_CODE', '/resources/images/icon_emptyimg.gif', '상품준비중', ' ', ' ', ' ', 0, ' ', (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND STD_CATEG_ID = '4') AS PID_CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE ROWNUM < 6 - (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM PRMTITEM A, ICOMBYCA B WHERE B.COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND A.CATEGORY_NO = B.STD_CATEG_ID AND B.PID = '2' AND A.STATUS = 'C')) WHERE PID = '2' AND ROWNUM < 6 UNION ALL SELECT PID, CATEGORY_NO, IMG_NAME, ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, MAKER_NAME, USER_PRICE, CATEG_NAME, PID_CATEG_NAME FROM (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM (SELECT A.PID, B.CATEGORY_NO, DECODE ( B.IMG_NAME, NULL, '/resources/images/icon_emptyimg.gif', '/' || B.IMG_DIR || '/' || B.IMG_NAME) IMG_NAME, B.ITEM_NO, B.DESCRIPTION, B.SPECIFICATION, B.MAKER_NAME, B.USER_PRICE, A.CATEG_NAME, (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = A.COM_CODE AND STD_CATEG_ID = A.PID) AS PID_CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA A, PRMTITEM B WHERE A.STD_CATEG_ID = B.CATEGORY_NO AND A.PID = '3' AND A.COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND B.STATUS = 'C') ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.RANDOM) UNION ALL
SELECT '3' AS PID, ' ', '/resources/images/icon_emptyimg.gif', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', 0, ' ', (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND STD_CATEG_ID = '5') AS PID_CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE ROWNUM < 6 - (SELECT COUNT (*) FROM PRMTITEM A, ICOMBYCA B WHERE B.COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND A.CATEGORY_NO = B.STD_CATEG_ID AND B.PID = '3' AND A.STATUS = 'C')) WHERE PID = '3' AND ROWNUM < 6

/*"getPromoteCatalogList"*/ SELECT DECODE (IMG_NAME, NULL, '/resources/images/icon_emptyimg.gif', '/' || IMG_DIR || '/' || IMG_NAME) IMG_NAME, ITEM_NO ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION DESCRIPTION, USER_PRICE USER_PRICE, CATEGORY_NO CATEGORY_NO, (SELECT PID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND STD_CATEG_ID = CATEGORY_NO) PID FROM PRMTITEM WHERE STATUS IN ('C', 'R', 'V')
AND ${st_key_type} LIKE '%'||#{st_key_src}||'%'
AND ITEM_NO LIKE '%'||#{st_detail_item_no}||'%'
AND MAKER_NAME LIKE '%'||#{st_detail_maker_name}||'%'
AND DESCRIPTION LIKE '%'||#{st_detail_description}||'%'
AND SPECIFICATION LIKE '%'||#{st_detail_specification}||'%'
AND USER_PRICE BETWEEN #{st_detail_min_user_price} AND NVL(#{st_detail_max_user_price},100000000)
AND CATEGORY_NO IN (SELECT STD_CATEG_ID FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE='PRMTITEM' AND PID= #{st_pid} )
AND CATEGORY_NO = #{st_std_categ_id}
ORDER BY ITEM_NO DESC
ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.RANDOM

/*"getCategoryListThis"*/ SELECT STD_CATEG_ID, CATEG_NAME FROM (SELECT STD_CATEG_ID, CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND STD_CATEG_ID = #{st_pid} UNION SELECT STD_CATEG_ID, CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = 'PRMTITEM' AND PID = #{st_pid}) X ORDER BY TO_NUMBER (X.STD_CATEG_ID)

'), CHR(13), '
